# Gap test summary (generated by 04_gap_and_tests.py)

Settings: filled = >= 3 shared anime in 2015+; top = top 10%; 20 popularity bins; seed 42

- tags: 220; pairs never combined in 2000-2014: 9200; filled later: 1214 (13.2% base rate)
- backbone used for the network predictor: 1693 edges

## 1. Each predictor alone (AUC: 0.5 = useless, 1 = perfect)
- popularity: 0.693
- network (neighbour overlap): 0.559
- text, synopsis TF-IDF: 0.659
- text, description TF-IDF: 0.559

## 2. Does text add anything beyond popularity?  (and beyond popularity + network)
Null: tag texts permuted among tags of similar popularity, 1000 times.
- synopsis TF-IDF:
    - top pairs fill at 26.4% vs 22.2% for same-popularity pairs: excess +4.2% (null mean +0.0%, p = 0.0160, 1000 permutations)
    - same, also matched on network overlap: 26.4% vs 23.8%: excess +2.6% (null mean -0.5%, p = 0.0350)
    - AUC 0.659 vs null mean 0.606 (p = 0.0010)
- description TF-IDF:
    - top pairs fill at 17.6% vs 12.0% for same-popularity pairs: excess +5.7% (null mean -0.0%, p = 0.0030, 1000 permutations)
    - same, also matched on network overlap: 17.6% vs 12.9%: excess +4.7% (null mean -0.1%, p = 0.0100)
    - AUC 0.559 vs null mean 0.505 (p = 0.0010)

## 3. Does network position add anything beyond popularity?  (and beyond popularity + text)
Null: degree-preserving rewiring of the backbone, 200 times.
- top pairs fill at 18.2% vs 8.9% for same-popularity pairs: excess +9.3% (null mean -0.1%, p = 0.0050)
- same, also matched on synopsis similarity: 18.2% vs 9.1%: excess +9.1% (null mean -0.3%, p = 0.0050)
- AUC 0.559 vs null mean 0.481 (p = 0.0050)
